provenance: krateo-platformops/portal tag 1.8.85 (commit 83155739ad43f6f64027e5e4a1e7f081ad44ed8f), the portal chart run 20 installed; extracted by rendering .Release.Namespace/.Values.namespace to krateo-system and dropping template comments

compositions-list.filter:
(((.projects // "") | split(",") | map(select(. != ""))) as $projSel
 | ((.project // .namespace) // "") as $proj
 | if ($projSel | length) > 0 then $projSel elif $proj != "" then [$proj] else [] end) as $projects
| (.status // "all") as $status | (.scope // "workloads") as $scope | ((.q // "") | ascii_downcase) as $q | now as $now | ((.allCompositions // []) | map(select(($projects | length) == 0 or (([.ns] - $projects) | length == 0))) | map(. + ((.conditions // []) as $c | (any($c[]?; .type == "Ready" and .status == "True")) as $ready | (any($c[]?; .type == "Ready" and .status == "False")) as $notready | (any($c[]?; .type == "Synced" and .status == "False")) as $unsynced | ($ready and (.wh == false)) as $degraded | {conditions: ((.conditions // []) + (if .wh == false then [{type: "Workload", status: "False", reason: "Unhealthy", message: (.whMsg // "")}] else [] end)), state: (if $notready then "failed" elif $degraded then "degraded" elif $ready then "healthy" else "pending" end), railState: (if $notready then "failed" elif $degraded then "degraded" elif $ready and ($unsynced | not) then "healthy" elif $ready and $unsynced then "drift" else "pending" end), healthPercent: (if $notready then 20 elif $degraded then 50 elif $ready and ($unsynced | not) then 100 elif $ready and $unsynced then 50 else 50 end)}))) as $all | $all as $dated | ($dated | map(select(if $scope == "all" then true elif $scope == "platform" then .platform else (.platform | not) end))) as $scoped | {
    list: $all,
    filtered: ($scoped | map(select((if $status == "drift" then (.railState == "drift") else ($status == "all" or .state == $status) end) and ($q == "" or ((.name // "") | ascii_downcase | contains($q)) or ((.kind // "") | ascii_downcase | contains($q)))))),
    counts: {all: ($scoped | length), healthy: ($scoped | map(select(.state == "healthy")) | length), drift: ($scoped | map(select(.railState == "drift")) | length), pending: ($scoped | map(select(.state == "pending")) | length), degraded: ($scoped | map(select(.state == "degraded")) | length), failed: ($scoped | map(select(.state == "failed")) | length)},
    scopeCounts: {workloads: ($dated | map(select(.platform | not)) | length), platform: ($dated | map(select(.platform)) | length), all: ($dated | length)},
    scope: $scope,
    status: $status,
    q: ((.q // "") | tostring),
    projects: ((.projects // "") | tostring)
  }

stages.filter: [.crds.items[]? | select(.status.resource != null and .status.apiVersion != null) | {plural: .status.resource, version: (.status.apiVersion | split("/")[1])}] | unique
stages.name: crds

stages.filter:
[.allCompositions.items[]?
 | {uid: .metadata.uid, name: .metadata.name, ns: .metadata.namespace, ts: .metadata.creationTimestamp, kind: .kind, av: .apiVersion, conditions: (.status.conditions // []), wh: .status.workloadHealthy, whMsg: (.status.healthMessage // ""), platform: ((((.metadata.labels // {})["krateo.io/composition-name"]) == "installer") or (((.metadata.labels // {})["krateo.io/composition-definition-name"]) == "installer"))}]
stages.name: allCompositions

stages.filter: [.crds.items[]? | select(.status.resource != null and .status.apiVersion != null) | {plural: .status.resource, version: (.status.apiVersion | split("/")[1])}] | unique
stages.name: crds

stages.filter:
[.allCompositions.items[]?
 | {uid: .metadata.uid, name: .metadata.name, ns: .metadata.namespace, ts: .metadata.creationTimestamp, kind: .kind, av: .apiVersion, conditions: (.status.conditions // [])}]
stages.name: allCompositions

widgetDataTemplate.expression: ${ ((.scope // "workloads") | tostring) as $sel | (.scopeCounts // {}) as $counts | ((.status // "") | tostring) as $status | ((.q // "") | tostring) as $q | ((.projects // "") | tostring) as $projects | ((if $status != "" then ("&status=" + ($status | @uri)) else "" end) + (if $q != "" then ("&q=" + ($q | @uri)) else "" end) + (if $projects != "" then ("&projects=" + ($projects | @uri)) else "" end)) as $carry | [{key: "workloads", label: "My workloads"}, {key: "platform", label: "Platform"}, {key: "all", label: "Everything"}] | map({label: .label, count: ($counts[.key] // 0), active: (.key == $sel), route: ("/compositions?scope=" + .key + $carry)}) }

${ ((.status // "all") | tostring) as $sel | (.counts // {}) as $counts | ((.q // "") | tostring) as $q | ((.projects // "") | tostring) as $projects | ((.scope // "") | tostring) as $scope | ((if $q != "" then ("&q=" + ($q | @uri)) else "" end) + (if $projects != "" then ("&projects=" + ($projects | @uri)) else "" end) + (if $scope != "" then ("&scope=" + ($scope | @uri)) else "" end)) as $carry | [{key: "all", label: "All"}, {key: "healthy", label: "Healthy"}, {key: "drift", label: "Drift"}, {key: "pending", label: "Pending"}, {key: "degraded", label: "Degraded"}, {key: "failed", label: "Failed"}] | map({label: .label, count: ($counts[.key] // 0), active: (.key == $sel), route: ("/compositions?status=" + .key + $carry)}) }

${ (if .slice then (.filtered[.slice.offset : (.slice.offset + .slice.perPage)]) else .filtered end) as $rows | [ $rows[] | [ {valueKey:"name",kind:"jsonSchemaType",type:"string",stringValue:.name}, {valueKey:"kind",kind:"jsonSchemaType",type:"string",stringValue:.kind}, {valueKey:"ns",kind:"jsonSchemaType",type:"string",stringValue:.ns}, {valueKey:"status",kind:"conditions",stringValue:(((.conditions // []) | sort_by([(if .type=="Ready" then 0 elif .type=="Synced" then 1 else 2 end), .type]) | map({type:(if .status=="True" then .type elif .status=="False" then (if .type=="Workload" then "Unhealthy" else ("Not" + .type) end) else (.type + "Unknown") end), status:.status, color:(if .status=="True" then "green" elif .status=="False" then "red" else "gray" end)})) | tojson)}, {valueKey:"reconcile",kind:"tag",stringValue:( .railState | if .=="healthy" then "Converged" elif .=="failed" then "Failed" elif .=="drift" then "Drift" elif .=="degraded" then "Degraded" else "Pending" end),color:( .railState | if .=="healthy" then "green" elif .=="failed" then "red" elif .=="drift" then "violet" elif .=="degraded" then "orange" else "orange" end )}, {valueKey:"age",kind:"jsonSchemaType",type:"string",stringValue:.ts,format:"relative"} ] ] }

${ . as $r | ($r.range // "all") as $range | (if $range=="24h" then {n:24,step:3600} elif $range=="7d" then {n:8,step:86400} elif $range=="30d" then {n:31,step:86400} else {n:15,step:86400} end) as $cfg | (now|floor) as $now | ($now - ($now % $cfg.step)) as $end | (reduce ($r.list[]?) as $it ({}; (($it.ts // "") | (fromdateiso8601? // null)) as $e | if ($e|type) != "number" then . else ($e - ($e % $cfg.step)) as $b | .[($b|tostring)] = ((.[($b|tostring)] // 0) + 1) end)) as $counts | [ range(0; $cfg.n) | ($end - (. * $cfg.step)) as $b | { t: $b, series: "Created", v: ($counts[($b|tostring)] // 0) } ] | reverse }

${ . as $r | ($r.range // "all") as $range | (if $range=="24h" then {n:24,step:3600} elif $range=="7d" then {n:8,step:86400} elif $range=="30d" then {n:31,step:86400} else {n:15,step:86400} end) as $cfg | (now|floor) as $now | ($now - ($now % $cfg.step)) as $end | (reduce ($r.list[]?) as $it ({}; (($it.ts // "") | (fromdateiso8601? // null)) as $e | if ($e|type) != "number" then . else ($e - ($e % $cfg.step)) as $b | .[($b|tostring)] = ((.[($b|tostring)] // 0) + 1) end)) as $counts | ([ range(0; $cfg.n) | ($end - (. * $cfg.step)) as $b | { t: $b, v: ($counts[($b|tostring)] // 0) } ] | reverse) as $d | ($d | max_by(.v)) as $peak | [ {type:"point", data:[{t:$peak.t, v:$peak.v}], encode:{x:"t", y:"v"}, scale:{color:{type:"identity"}}, style:{fill:"#F2A33C", stroke:"#070C12", lineWidth:2, r:6}, size:9, tooltip:false} ] }

${ (.list // []) as $l | ([ $l[].conditions[]?.type ] | unique) as $types | [ $types[] | . as $t | ([ $l[] | select(any(.conditions[]?; .type == $t and .status == "True")) ] | length) as $tc | ([ $l[] | select(any(.conditions[]?; .type == $t)) ] | length) as $n | { type: $t, percent: (if $n > 0 then ($tc * 100 / $n | floor) else 0 end), label: (($tc | tostring) + "/" + ($n | tostring)), route: (if $t == "Ready" then "/compositions?status=failed" else "" end) } ] }

${ if ((.list | type) == "array") and ((.list | length) == 0) then
     [
       { name: "Help me choose", icon: "fa-wand-magic-sparkles", color: "orange",
         description: "Not sure where to start? Ask Autopilot to guide you.",
         navigateTo: ("/marketplace?ask=" + ("Show me around and help me choose a blueprint to deploy." | @uri)) },
       { name: "Databases", icon: "fa-database", color: "cyan",
         description: "Provision managed databases and data stores.",
         navigateTo: ("/marketplace?q=database&ask=" + ("I want to set up a database — which blueprint fits?" | @uri)) },
       { name: "Networking", icon: "fa-network-wired", color: "cyan",
         description: "Set up networks, load balancers and connectivity.",
         navigateTo: ("/marketplace?q=network&ask=" + ("I want to configure networking — what are my options?" | @uri)) },
       { name: "Observability", icon: "fa-chart-line", color: "cyan",
         description: "Add metrics, logs and dashboards to your estate.",
         navigateTo: ("/marketplace?q=observability&ask=" + ("I want to add observability — which blueprint should I use?" | @uri)) }
     ]
   else [] end }
${ "Here's what's happening across your platform" + ({"24h":" in the last 24 hours","7d":" this week","30d":" this month","all":""}[.range // "all"]) }
${ ((.list | length) | tostring) + (if (.range // "all") == "all" then " total" else " new" end) }

${ (if (.list|length)>0 then ((([.list[]|select((.conditions//[])|(any(.type=="Ready" and (.status=="True" or .status=="False"))|not))]|length)*100/(.list|length))|floor) else 0 end | tostring) + "%" }

${ (.list // []) | group_by(.kind) | map({ kind: (.[0].kind // "—"), n: length }) | (([ .[].n ] | max) // 0) as $mx | sort_by(-.n) | .[0:10] | map({ kind: .kind, count: (.n | tostring), percent: (if $mx > 0 then (.n * 100 / $mx | floor) else 0 end), route: (if .kind == "—" then "" else ("/compositions?q=" + .kind) end) }) }

${ (.list // []) | group_by(.ns) | map({ ns: (.[0].ns // "—"), n: length }) | (([ .[].n ] | max) // 0) as $mx | sort_by(-.n) | .[0:10] | map({ ns: .ns, count: (.n | tostring), percent: (if $mx > 0 then (.n * 100 / $mx | floor) else 0 end) }) }
